Name: Achievements
Description: Everything in this game is unlocked here first — a room, a Brewery section, a brew, an emblem, a floodlight.
Notes: THE ROOT, AND THE ONLY DOOR WITH NO Requires. It is open from the first minute on purpose: a game whose unlock board is itself locked is a game with nothing to aim at. window: opens it OVER the base instead of cutting to a new scene - see base_window.gd.

Name: Team Build
Description: Your three Stars, the twelve who take the field, and the talents. Nothing is played until the first two are done.
Notes: ROUND Y: this was the Talent Tree. Its ID is unchanged on purpose - anything that points at talent_tree still finds it. It has NO Requires now, because the Pub and every match wait on it and a new game has to be able to reach it. The Talents tab inside still waits for unlocked:Talent Tree, so that unlock means what it always did. THE TALENT TREE AND THE STAR HALL ARE ONE BUILDING. Its ★ button swaps to the Star Hall, where three matching Stars open the Emblems - which have to be unlocked in Achievements first, like everything else.

Name: Club House
Description: The recruitment board, and where the team sleeps it off. Sign named players for coins; a player's P:x is how many fixtures they need before they can play again.
Notes: THE RECRUITMENT BOARD (round AH): data/RecruitBoard.csv. EXHAUSTION AND RECOVERY: a view onto recovery_book.gd, and `recovery` in Tuning.csv turns the whole thing on. How many players you may keep is the Dorms.

Name: Dorms
Description: Beds. How many players you are allowed to keep at all.
Notes: data/Dorms.csv. The first row is FREE and the rest are bought - the same shape as the Brewery's vats: the basic foundation free, everything bigger earned.

Name: Trophy Room
Description: Glass cases. Season trophies, and anything else you have been told to be proud of.
Notes: data/Trophies.csv. A trophy is a NAME AND A CONDITION - it does not have to come from a competition, so `three wins` is as good a trophy as a cup final.

Name: Training Ground
Description: Ausbildung for the whole side — or one of the five games that automate a Brewery section.
Notes: data/Training.csv, and the Kind column splits it: `ausbildung` trains a number, `minigame` automates a Brewery section. A mini-game buys that section another vat today; the played game goes on top of it later.

Name: Pub
Description: Ten seats, ten drinks, and a cheer. Whoever is not in the room plays as a basic unit.
Notes: TONIGHT'S TEN. `pub_ten` in Tuning.csv turns the ten-seat room on; while it is off, everybody may drink.

Name: Brewery
Description: Six sections and a yard. Barley in at one end, bottles out at the other.
Notes: OPENS ITS OWN MAP inside the window. Each of the six sections is unlocked separately, and a section with player units in it will one day produce on its own after every match - the Batches column is where that foundation already sits.

Name: The Traveling Brewer
Description: A cart, a mule and a man who knows exactly what you have run out of.
Notes: HE IS THE PRESSURE VALVE ON THE BREWERY, and he sells one thing at a time at a premium. The money is data/Currencies.csv and every match mode has its own - a season match pays coins, a quick match pays marks, a cup tie pays silver.
